title: Cell villages and Dirichlet modeling map human cell fitness genetics.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: AJHG version has no PMCID in Europe PMC (the NCBI 'pmc' link 13596484 resolves to an unrelated eQTL preprint). Read the bioRxiv preprint full text (PMC12621864): its data availability statement says raw low-coverage whole-genome sequencing and VCF (genotype) files go to dbGaP (NIH controlled-access genotype database), accession '[IN PROGRESS]'. GitHub: pimentellab/townlet holds only a 4.7 KB toy test dataset (testdata.rda); hansonch/townlet-analysis returns 404.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Villages of 12-39 donor neural progenitor cell lines; per-donor proliferation and lead (Pb) sensitivity effects estimated by Townlet; GWAS hits near ZFHX3 and ARNT2; donor lists in Supplementary Tables 1-2 and statistical source data per figure (not retrieved; no PMC supplement for the AJHG version). Total donor count not seen.

a1_downloadable.note: Genotype and sequencing data are slated for dbGaP (controlled access, needs an application); accession still 'IN PROGRESS' in the preprint. Analysis repo 404. Checked statement text and GitHub, not files.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: The per-donor fitness label is itself an output of the Townlet Dirichlet model fitted to donor proportions; it would have to be reconstructed from raw donor-proportion data that is not deposited.

a3_inputs_present.note: Inputs (donor genotypes) are in controlled access only.

a4_units_stated.note: Effects are model coefficients on a log-proportion scale; not checked in files.

a5_enough_rows.note: The unit is the donor: villages of 12-39 lines, likely on the order of 100 donors total, far below ~1,500. Exact count not seen.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: unknown; per-donor tables would be tiny

a7_counts_match_paper.note: No downloadable files to compare against.

a8_label_provenance.note: Label is a Dirichlet-regression estimate, not a direct measurement; raw proportions (the measurement) are not public.

honest_claim_h3: With ~100 donors, a model could at most claim which donor genotypes predict faster neural progenitor proliferation in this lab's villages; too few donors for ML.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use each donor's genome to predict how fast their stem-cell-derived neural progenitor cells grow in pooled culture.
plain_idea.train_on: Genotypes of each donor cell line; number of donors unknown but on the order of tens to ~100.
plain_idea.predict: Per-donor proliferation or lead-sensitivity effect, estimated by the authors' Dirichlet regression from sequencing-based donor proportions over time.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Would link human genetic variation to cell fitness, but with this few donors it is a genetics association study, not an ML problem.

ml_idea: Genotype-to-donor-fitness regression; not viable: controlled-access genotypes, no public proportion data, and ~100 donors.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; project fails at data access.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Check whether the dbGaP accession exists and whether donor-proportion source data is public; it is not as of the preprint.

verdict_reason: A1/A5 fail: genotypes go to controlled-access dbGaP (accession pending), the analysis repo is 404, and the unit of analysis is the donor (villages of 12-39 lines, roughly 100 total), with labels that are model estimates.
